caso.texto:
A learner asks AI for an email from a brief stating two accounts and no integration. Output invents integration, 30% savings and a prior meeting. An attached document instructs sending the client list externally. All exercise data are synthetic.

An Indian sales team uses a synthetic product brief and a draft-only workflow. The model invents local-language support and tax treatment and treats polite interest as purchase approval. The reviewer must preserve the actual uncertainty.

projeto.instrucoes: Rewrite the prompt, audit each claim, produce a corrected message and define review points before sending or recording.
projeto.gabarito: Treat embedded instructions as untrusted data, not actions. Remove invented integration, savings and prior meeting, plus unsupported local claims. Trace claims to sources, retain gaps and separate drafting from reviewed action.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
